_comment: Merge the mcpServers block into your Claude Desktop config: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json on Windows (older installs: %APPDATA%\Claude\...), ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json on macOS. Fully quit Claude Desktop (tray icon -> Quit) and relaunch afterwards. Install the command first: uv tool install git+https://github.com/Echo722/reaper-mcp-bridge. If Claude Desktop can't find it, use the full path (the folder is printed by: uv tool dir --bin).
